programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Magna, the body of a man is found who had apparently drowned himself. It is discovered later that he was desperately seeking a way out of bankruptcy after visiting a local millionaire to get back his money from a scheme he had invested in. The post-mortem says that he was indeed murdered. Whilst DS Troy assists a pretty wildlife liaison officer with an investigation into the illegal sale of protected birds eggs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. DCI Barnaby begins his investigations when it is found that one skeleton had modern dental work. Meanwhile, DS Troy, having been promoted to Inspector has his last case in Midsomer, to look into the murder of a youth, Simon Mayfield (Henry Cavill), who had caused problems for many in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. He is instantly involved in his first case, a woman stabbed after attending a Spanish-themed evening in Midsomer Mallow. Not long after, a retired doctor for whom she had worked is murdered during the village's annual garden open day. It quickly becomes clear that the two victims knew a secret about one of the villagers. Are both crimes connected?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. In present day, Roger's son Gareth is killed with the spear, after having altercations with several villagers. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. But it is discovered that he had had his neck expertly broken before his tumble down the stairs. The village's 12th annual Literary festival brings feuding writers, publishers, and editors to town. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village pub of Midsomer Worthy, The Maid in Splendour, is the workplace of many locals. One night, popular barman Jamie Cruickshank is found dead near an abandoned cottage in the woods. The new manager Stephen Bannerman, who is thoroughly disliked by many, wants to sell the Maid to property developers in secret. When Stephen is murdered, Barnaby and Scott have to find out whether Jamie or Stephen was the intended target of the first murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Parva have all come out one evening to see the revival of an old Pagan festival. The centrepiece is a straw effigy of a woman. When it is set alight and people look on in wonder, it soon turns to horror when the local curate screams out in pain from within the effigy. The villagers quickly turn against Liz Francis, a local teacher who had organised the event.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Nine years after Ferdy Villiers committed suicide at the family home of Draycott Hall, the extended Villiers family gather together to celebrate Christmas. When a riddle in a Christmas cracker proclaims that two members of the family will be dead by midnight on Boxing Day, everyone takes no notice, until elderly Aunt Lydia nearly dies after getting locked in the garage, after her car has restarted itself and then later in the night, falls down the stairs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.sub-title: Things That Go Bump In The Night
programme.desc: Undertaker Patrick Pennyman is found dead in the village of Fletcher's Cross, in his own chapel of rest, by his wife. Barnaby and Scott start looking into a spiritualist church in the village that had been heavily controversial. Elizabeth, a friend of Joyce, who had attended their meetings, tells her that she was suspicious of both the spiritualist church and the undertaker and believed they were acquiring information and stealing from the dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the Midsomer Regatta, the day is interrupted by the body of Guy Sweetman, Chairman of the local rowing club, resurfacing midway through a race. Barnaby and Scott learn that Guy was a ladies' man with many past conquests. He had been in secret meetings with a few other members. The two detectives uncover lies, blackmail, jealousy and a planned robbery, before the latest woman Guy was planning to marry is attacked and almost killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a local handyman finds a female classics teacher and a member of a group of orchid enthusiasts poisoned in her own home, DCI Barnaby finds himself heading back to Midsomer Malham, the day after he and Joyce had helped out during the village's annual garden show. It is discovered that the victim had a secret lover and had helped to smuggle a rare one-of-a-kind orchid, the Yellow Roth, out of Borneo.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A successful day at the races for the racehorse, Bantling Boy, the previous day, it is not long before one of the horses' owners is found murdered in the horses' stables. The victim, Bruce Hartley, had been in dispute with the other owners of Bantling Boy, the night before his murder had had a rather heated argument with them and had refused to let them acceptance of an offer to buy the horse. It seems to make things a whole lot worse of the others in the syndicate.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

He soon forgets the life he unwillingly left behind and is adopted by an Apache family. For close to a decade, he lives as a Native American, learning their language and customs. Eventually, he even joins the same type of raiding party that separated him from his family. Though the years pass by, Herman's mother never gives up hope that she will be reunited with her son. programme.title: Wild West Chronicles

Along the way, Hughes decides to become a Ranger himself and transforms from loner to lawman. programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After escaping the bonds of slavery, Bass Reeves takes refuge among the indigenous people of The Indian Territory, where he is welcomed into their culture. When the Civil War ends, his new-found tracking skills and fluency in native languages lead to his appointment as the first Black Deputy U.S. Marshal west of the Mississippi River. Though he faces discrimination from his peers, Reeves earns their respect when he accepts Judge Isaac Parker's daunting order to hunt down one of the most ruthless killers in The Indian Territory and bring him back dead or alive. Some years later, Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, interviews Judge Parker to learn more about the amazing career of Bass Reeves, who goes on to arrest 3,000 felons, kill 14 men in self-defense, and complete 32 years of service without being wounded.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Wild Bill Hickok & the First Quick-Draw Duel
programme.desc: Wild Bill Hickok and his buddy, Davis Tutt, see their friendship fall apart over gambling debts and the affections of a beautiful woman. After Tutt swipes Wild Bill's prized timepiece as payback for a disputed debt, things begin to heat up. Then, when Tutt parades through town with the watch in one hand and Hickok's former girlfriend in the other, Wild Bill's blood begins to boil. Tutt refuses to return the watch, and he continues to flaunt the beautiful woman on his arm. The two men meet in the middle of town to settle their differences once and for all in what will become the very first quick-draw duel of the Old West. Both men reach for their pistols at the same time and fire! In an attempt to separate the truth from the fiction, Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, interviews George Ward Nichols, the journalist who immortalized the duel and created the legend of Wild Bill Hickok.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

Dr. Phil digs deep in search of answers. Is “Kelly” really the woman of Steve’s dreams, or is he being conned by a catfish? programme.title: Stepdads The Sketch- Ep 1
programme.desc: When infidelity claims the life of Joanne Bates, her children Lisa and Stevie are left in the custody of her fiancé Mike and his brother Jerry. Mike, a straight-laced, hardworking accountant; and Jerry, a wild, unstable, womanizer were both former foster children and together they provide a unique balance of parenting skills for young Lisa and Stevie. - Step Dads starring Ben Sloane (R.I.P.D, Alpha House), Morocco Omari (Empire, 21 Bridges, Homeland, Chicago Fire), Jorie Binion (Chicago P.D) Charles Dunlap (Chicago Fire, Empire), and Jay Davis (Not Another Black Movie, Choke On That: The Series, Not Another Zombie Movie) is a comedy about two polar opposite foster brothers raising two children using non-traditional parenting methods while shedding a satirical light on the importance of adoption. We poke fun at some of the mishaps which comes along with the shock of being a new parent, but ultimately, we hope to spread awareness on adoption, the importance of having fathers and father-figures in the lives of young people, and having a familial loving environment. The moral of our story is that “No family is perfect, but every child deserves to be loved unconditionally, and raised in a reliable, stable support system.”

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.

programme.desc: A relaxing weekend in the country turns into a nightmare for an Arkansas family when their teen son never shows up. programme.title: The Making of the Mob: Chicago

programme.title: The Making of the Mob: Chicago
programme.desc: Peace ends in Chicago when Torrio and Capone seek revenge against the Irish gangs; the "Beer Wars" put Capone on top.

programme.title: The Making of the Mob: Chicago
programme.desc: When Capone asserts his power via the St. Valentine's Day Massacre, President Hoover takes notice; Eliot Ness decides to take on Capone.

programme.title: When Girls Ride
programme.desc: When Samantha leaves the South to have a fresh start with her husband, she ends up meeting two biker girls named Raquel and Tammy. The women respond accordingly in order to get justice for their friend.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

programme.title: Bottled Lust
programme.desc: Jasmine and her friends embark on a girls trip, as well as mend her heartbreak. She then meets John and is hit with a wave of feelings and butterflies. But when John starts to show his true colors, the girls end up in a dangerous situation.

programme.title: The Housekeeper 2
programme.desc: After moving on from her sordid past, Sharease flourishes in her new life and success. When her son Adonis kidnapped, she seeks help from a ghost of her past to rescue him.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Black Game Night
programme.desc: A group of friends prepare to attend The Blacks’ annual game night, but make a chilling discovery when the arrive to find the hosts have been brutally murdered. In their pursuit to uncover the murderer, secrets unravel and betrayals are discovered, winning no longer becomes the goal – it’s surviving.

programme.title: Meli
programme.desc: After finding an eviction notice on her door, Meli decides it’s time to up the ante and take matters into her own hands to protect her family by any means necessary. Out of pure desperation she attempts to burglarize a stranger’s luxurious home.

programme.title: Nothing Even Matters
programme.desc: Paroled after 5 years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by an acquaintance, Benny, and her mother. Their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder. As he falls for a woman named Bear, Travis must escape the web of secrets and lies he's trapped in, fighting for survival and the love he's found.

programme.title: Murder Gardens 2
programme.desc: After serving 10 years in prison, Chase returns to Miami Gardens with a goal of reclaiming his life. But the criminal empire that he was once part of has changed and his older brother Rell is now one of the heads in charge. He recruits Chase for one last job, but things are about to spiral out of control.

programme.title: A Secret Lie in Love
programme.desc: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. However, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity, and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man, while Chase’s greed seems to unravel everything they’ve built. Will their marriage survive?

programme.title: Heart of a Woman
programme.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: Twisted Marriage
programme.desc: Dexter and Ashley are a married couple, who are close friends with Mary and Paul. On a whim, they decide to swing spouses for the weekend, which leads to questions about their feelings and if their marriages will survive.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: In February 1917 World War I is raging when Mata Hari is arrested in Paris and taken to the examining magistrate. Her very life is at stake: she is accused of high treason. The famous exotic dancer has come to represent beauty and the power of feminine seduction. The documentary Mata Hari - the Beautiful Spy tracks down the true story of this fascinating woman.

programme.title: Osama Bin Laden - Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Just after midnight on May 2, 2011, United States Special Forces raided the compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan, where Osama Bin laden had been hiding for years. “America’s public enemy number one” was killed during the operation. The Navy SEALs thoroughly searched his house, recovering everything that could provide information about Bin Laden and his terrorist network Al-Qaeda: His documents and private correspondence, as well as every electronic data carrier.

programme.title: The Child Crusades - Barefoot to the Promised Land
programme.desc: In Cologne in 1212 a boy named Nicholas captivated thousands of children between the ages of eight and fifteen with his fanatical speeches. They had been chosen, he said, to liberate Jerusalem. Likewise, in the French town of Cloyes a young shepherd gathered numerous children around him with the same proclamation.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: In the first episode of the three-part series, The Biblical Plagues, scholars deal with the first six natural disasters. In the Nile, scientists discovered deadly microorganisms that caused the fish to die and a stress situation among the frog population.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: For a long time, scientists have tried to prove that nine of the Ten Plagues described in the Old Testament point to a serious breakdown of the climate, triggering an ecological chain reaction. Apart from theological considerations, scholars all over the world have studied individual phenomena, trying to explain the causes of this Biblical disaster.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… and the Lord sent thunder and hail, … and fire mingled with the hail,” reports the Old Testament. “And the hail smote … all that was in the field, both man and beast.” (Exodus 9:23–25).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... locusts … invaded all Egypt …. They covered all the ground until it was black,” reports the Bible. “They devoured … everything growing in the fields … – nothing green remained on trees or palms in all the lands of Egypt.” (Exodus 10:14–15). Swarms of locusts are still a very real plague today.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… darkness that can be felt … covered all Egypt for three days,” reports the Bible. “No one could see anyone else … for three days.” (Exodus 10:22–23). Dust storms frequently paralyze public life during the storm season in many of the most arid regions of the Earth, burying roads and human settlements, threatening the lives of humans and animals alike.

programme.title: Children of the Wild
programme.desc: In many cultures there are myths about “wolf children” who were taken from their families and then grew up in the wild, either alone or with wolves, bears or other animals. But how close are such stories to reality? This program offers a combination of two stories: the true story of the monkey boy John Ssebunya in Uganda, and that of Rudyard Kipling’s Mowgli, the most famous, albeit fictitious, wolf child of all. Unlike the children in the myths and stories, children who grow up without human beings have massive problems integrating themselves into society. The program specifically follows the fate of the young Ugandan boy John Ssebunya. If there is no human being as communication partner in the first years of a child’s life, the wolf child will yelp, growl, scream or grunt. He is not yet ready to make contact with other children.

programme.title: In Search of Santa Claus
programme.desc: The amazing transformation of a holy man from Turkey into the world-wide symbol of Christmas cheer. He's one of the most widely recognized figures in the world; but what are the origins of St. Nicholas, and how did he become Santa Claus? With criminological acumen, this one-hour documentary sorts the myths from the facts to present the true story of the first multi-national saint, revered by the Catholic, Protestant and Orthodox churches alike.

programme.title: The Secret of the Phaistos Code
programme.desc: Is the Phaistos Disc a clever fake? The film follows the trail of possibly one of the greatest archaeological scandals ever. The search for the truth starts in the ancient Cretan palace complexes of Phaistos. The North American art dealer Jerome Eisenberg, one of the world’s foremost forgery experts, considers the “Phaistos Disc” to be a latter-day fake. In 1908, it was discovered by the Italian archaeologist Luigi Pernier. Since then, the disc has aroused the scientific ambition of countless linguists. The British academic Gareth Owens has analyzed new archaeological discoveries with unfamiliar characters and believes the disc to be genuine. But Eisenberg remains convinced that the disc cannot be deciphered at all. He claims that not only does it not reveal a text that has ever been decipherable, but also that is not even of ancient origin.

programme.title: The Advance of the Hanseatic League
programme.desc: At the bottom of the Baltic Sea lies a cog, a relic of the might of the German Hanse, a league of merchantmen founded about 1200 AD. Archaeologists are retracing its final voyage using state of the art technology as well as ancient scripts. Their search takes them to the Norwegian port of Bergen, to the Shetlands and even as far as Iceland.

programme.title: Expedition in the South Seas
programme.desc: He is one of the greatest German explorers of all time even though his name fell into oblivion: As luck would have it, in 1772 17-year-old Georg Forster was given the chance to accompany the greatest navigator of his time, James Cook, on his world circumnavigation. On this voyage, Captain Cook discovered islands and peoples, while Georg Forster focused on animals and plants, discovering more than 400 species that had been unknown to Europeans until then. “Terra X” follows German actor Robert Atzorn on his search for traces around the world. He gets to know a young man, whose philosophy and conception of the world still appear to be really modern. Sophisticated dramatic reconstructions bring the fateful sea journey to life. The film portrays a great natural scientist whose knowledge and legacy determined patterns for scientific research in the 21st century.

programme.title: The Deadly Treasure of Lake Kivu
programme.desc: In Lake Kivu, on the borders of Rwanda and Congo, there is methane gas worth $25 billion. Enough to supply central Africa’s energy needs for generations. But if it explodes, it will kill up to two and a half million people living on Lake Kivu’s shores. The danger is real.

programme.title: In Search of the Golden Fleece
programme.desc: When Jason and his crew of 50 men set sail, a dangerous journey to what was then known as the end of the world lies ahead of the Greek heroes. The young hero had a one-of-a-kind galley built for the voyage, which he baptized "Argo." The mighty rowing boat was designed to take the committed band to the legendary land of Colchis, beyond the Dardanelles.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: For most Europeans, the wolf is more of a myth than an actual wild animal. But since the nineties, Isengrim has been making his way back to the middle of the continent, kilometre by painstaking kilometre. Part One of ‘Wandering Wolves’ follows the renowned biologist Francesca Marucco and other experts on the trail of an Italian nomad wolf on his way to the French Maritime Alps.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: In Part Two of the documentary, the wolf experts Luigi Boitani, Francesca Marucco, Ilka Reinhardt and Hubert Potocnik track the animals all the way across Europe. We see how wolves often cover over a thousand kilometres on their migrations. They swim through fast-flowing rivers and traverse icy mountain ranges and multi-lane motorways.

programme.title: Casanova - the Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Giacomo Casanova was born in Venice in 1725, to poor parents. Initially, he is expected to become a priest, but he is ultimately going to reject this career path. His destiny is governed by the love of women, and he challenges the most powerful institutions of his time: the Catholic Church and the Venetian Inquisition. For Casanova, life in decadent Venice is an on-going feast for the senses.

programme.desc: The war moves in favor of the Allies; the Japanese are defeated at Guadalcanal.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: In May 1905, Russia's Pacific squadron arrives at the Tsushima Strait.

programme.desc: Sergeant Cleo Lehenbauer, nicknamed 'Indestructible,' is wounded during the 101st Airborne's D-Day jump and after being hospitalized returns to Normandy. After conflicts with his commander in the 5th Armored Division, he transfers back to the 101st, where he helps stop the last major German offensive.

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 4

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 5

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 9

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 10

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)

Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.sub-title: Crafting Cabinet Doors: Materials & Cutting Techniques
programme.desc: In the episode the craftsman guides viewers through essential techniques and considerations for crafting cabinet doors with precision and efficiency. He begins by stressing the importance of wood selection, advising against woods with prominent grain patterns like oak, which are unsuitable for door frames. Instead, he recommends using straight-grained pieces from the edges of the wood or opting for materials like MDF, birch, or maple for paint-grade projects due to their smooth surfaces and availability in large sheets. The craftsman demonstrates how to prepare materials for construction, including ripping pieces for frames and face frames, and discusses the suitability of poplar for practice due to its affordability and ease of machining. When it comes to door panels, he explains the careful use of plywood and the importance of adjusting grooves precisely for optimal fit. He showcases the use of a dado head to create tenons that snugly fit into these grooves, ensuring strong and gap-free assembly. Techniques for creating specific door styles are highlighted, such as using half-lap joints adjusted on the table saw for flush fits. The craftsman emphasizes marking and consistent cuts to avoid errors, crucial for achieving perfect joints in door frame assembly. He demonstrates assembly steps and discusses adding decorative pegs for both aesthetic appeal and structural integrity, particularly useful for heavier doors like those with leaded glass panels. Throughout the episode, the craftsman underscores the use of templates for ensuring consistent shapes, particularly useful for cathedral-style doors. He employs a band saw and router table with double-sided tape to achieve precision in shaping components, emphasizing careful setup and sequential cuts for optimal woodworking results. Overall, the episode provides comprehensive guidance on wood selection, tool adjustment, joint creation, and assembly techniques, empowering woodworkers to create high-quality cabinet doors effectively.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—who's after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programme.title: Seven Guns for the MacGregors
programme.desc: Ranch owner MacGregor has seven sons and oldest Gregor leads his brothers to Las Mesas, a small town where they want to sell horses. They get into trouble with local people who are related with evil Santillana. After getting imprisoned and losing their horses they decide to go after Santillana's gang.

programme.title: Days of Violence
programme.desc: In the final months of the Civil War, Joe’s brother is unjustly slain by a Northern captain. Consumed by grief and fury, Joe joins a band of Southern fighters who refuse to surrender, seeking justice and redemption amid the dying embers of war.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of "Crooked Sky" and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: Rattler Kid
programme.desc: Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury, Tony Garrett escapes prison and sets out to find the real criminals responsible. As he hunts for revenge, he faces dangers and uncovers dark truths, determined to clear his name and make the true culprits pay for their actions.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: His Name was King
programme.desc: A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: As a child, Johnny witnessed his father’s death at the hands of soldiers. Now an outlaw, he seeks revenge by killing soldiers whenever possible. Lieutenant Garringo is tasked with capturing Johnny and bringing him back alive. A dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with Garringo determined to fulfill his mission.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: After Dan Hogan and his gang rob a bank, they hire a mysterious man to guide them across the Mexican border in return for half of the loot.

programme.title: And God Said to Cain
programme.desc: After ten years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, ex-Confederate officer Gary Hamilton returns to seek revenge on Acombar, the man who framed him and stole both his gold and his lover. Surrounded by enemies, Hamilton uses the town’s secret tunnels to strike back in a stormy, haunting showdown.

programme.title: Savage Pampas
programme.desc: In the late 1800's, an army captain tries to tame the open plains of Argentina which are dominated by Indians and bandits. To help do this, the captain brings in a party of women to keep his soldiers happy.

programme.title: Death on High Mountain
programme.desc: A major robbery spirals out of control when two young men cross paths with ruthless Mexican bandits and a corrupt businessman—both desperate to reclaim the stolen loot. Caught in a deadly chase, the youths face danger, betrayal, and the fight for survival.

programme.title: Adiós Gringo
programme.desc: A gunslinger on the run for a murder he didn't commit goes to New Mexico where he hopes to find a person who can exculpate him. While on his way he finds a girl who has been kidnapped and tortured, sets her free and then takes his revenge at gunpoint.

programme.title: A Few Bullets More
programme.desc: Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. When love gives him hope for change, Pat Garrett, a fatherly friend, helps him try to turn his life around. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Gentleman Killer
programme.desc: A border town is thrust into political chaos when a Mexican bandit targets US soldiers, killing them relentlessly. As tensions escalate between the US and Mexico, the bandit becomes a symbol of defiance. The town becomes a battleground, with both sides caught in a dangerous game of revenge and retaliation.

programme.title: Take Five
programme.desc: Five unlikely thieves are faced with the opportunity of a lifetime: a multi-million dollar robbery in a bank vault. At first united to carry out the plan, the gang members, however, allow themselves to be carried away by inexperience and avarice, each of them thinking of their own gain.

programme.title: The Clan
programme.desc: Franco and Dino, two mechanics from Rome, leave for Las Vegas to participate in the Harley-Davidson world meeting. They count on winning the reward provided for participants. But their real big dream is different. It is music. The two of them sing and dance to pieces by Frank Sinatra and Dean Martin without thinking that this could become a profession.

programme.title: The Cynic, the rat & the fist
programme.desc: A hardened cop, left for dead by a fugitive’s thugs he once arrested, rises again to relentlessly pursue them.

programme.title: The Pleasure
programme.desc: After the death of his wife, Gerard is left with only a few erotic recordings of Leonora. The woman's children come under the guardianship of Gerard, who is completely bewildered by Ursula's striking resemblance to their mother.

programme.desc: Policeman Dave Speed is not like any other policeman: as a result of an atomic explosion he acquired superpowers, which he uses to fight crime. However, his super strength has limits: the colour red nullifies his extraordinary abilities...

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

Whoever receives the most points, wins a one night stay for two people at this glamorous Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. On this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro and Mercedes SLS AMG try to impress.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: If you want to see out-of-this-world, customized or tuned luxury vehicles or posh cars you need to go to 'The Walk', the glamorous boulevard of Jumeirah Beach. Among the presented cars are a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: People from the Middle East are crazy about their cars. On Put Your Car on TV they have the chance to present their tuned vehicles and judged. Among the competitors are a Nova SS, a special Honda Acord and a car full of crystals.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.desc: A journey to Indianapolis unveils the winning car of the 1955 Indy 500 sits on the roof of an auto mechanic shop. More than 50 years after it’s magic at the track, prominent Indy mechanic/owner Chris Paulsen begins to restore the car and Ray talks about the evolution of America’s illustrious Indy 500.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: Travel Man

programme.title: Race Across the World

programme.desc: From Baku to Tashkent, the journey intensifies as four teams cross the Caspian Sea, weather a fierce storm, and traverse the deserts of Central Asia. With limited transport, deepening rivalries, and emotional reckonings, bonds are tested and strategies challenged. From camel farms to ancient cities along the Silk Road, each leg reveals breathtaking landscapes—and the harsh reality of racing across the unknown.

programme.desc: The race heats up as teams push across Kazakhstan into China, navigating border closures, sleepless trains, and emotional crossroads. Darren and Alex extend their lead but face personal tensions. Josh and Felix pursue inspiration and altitude, while Natalie and Shamima savor hard-won milestones. As the Great Wall looms and budgets thin, every decision could tip the scales in this epic global dash.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S02 E03 - Brazil - Piranha Soup
programme.desc: The guys reunite with Gisele, whom they had met on their previous trip to Jordan. A native to Brazil, Gisele shows them around Rio de Janeiro. She takes them hang gliding, to a football match, and into the ghettos before they hit the road for the Pantanal. Here they find poisonous plants, the worlds largest living rodents, and catch piranha for lunch - none of the reasons why Justin ends up in the hospital. This is a great opportunity for the guys to learn about Brazil’s dangers before reaching the Amazon.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S02 E04 - Brazil - Treading Water
programme.desc: There are so many things that can kill you in the Amazon. The guys rent a boat as protection and head down river to explore the rainforest. They find poisonous insects, angry snakes, and natives living in hand-built huts. After getting stuck in a 70 meter high tree in an Amazonian thunderstorm, and attacked by vicious pink dolphins, they hop on a plane headed for the island of Fernando de Noronha. Here they try their hand at scuba diving and witness the hatching of close to 1000 baby sea turtles. The dynamic changes when Justin and Gisele know their time together will soon be ending.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest

programme.desc: Ellis Emmett lives for adventure. Having conquered mountains and rivers in his homeland of New Zealand, his sights are now set on exploring the remote islands of the Pacific you can only get to by boat. The only trouble is, he doesn’t know how to sail. Ellis struggles with the physical and mental challenges of sailing but with help from friends both old and new, he finds his sea legs and sets off on his quest.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 105: El Robo y La Detencion
programme.desc: Luis Fernando insiste que quien le robo su carro fue el vigilante del edificio de enfrente, pone a todo el mundo en aviso, la presidenta del condominio le da los datos personales de Gerson. Mientras Gerson se dirige a su trabajo en compañía de Yuraima es esta seguro de que no pasa nada si llega un poco tarde ese día, se encuentran con que la policía detiene el trafico y la sorpresa es para ellos pues se llevan detenido a Gerson, el esta seguro de no haber hecho nada pero el agente le dice que tiene una denuncia por el robo de un carro y en ella aparece el nombre de el, Yuraima desesperada grita, pero igualito se lo llevan, ella se va para donde Gabito y le pide ayuda. En ese momento Gabito esta en compañía de Theo, quien aún no se le pasa la pena de la noche anterior, cuando llega Yuraima llorando y contándole a Gabito lo que acaba de ocurrir, Theo le dice que no puede ser por que ellos estaban en una fiesta la noche anterior, se van los tres para la jefatura, Gabito deja encargado de la bodega a Remedios pero a quien deja encargado de la caja es a Hector, pues en el si confía. La Nena le esta contando a Gladis el chasco de la noche anterior, Gladis le dice que todo le pasa por andar siempre con una mentira, que si hubiera sido sincera no le pasan tantas cosas. En la casa de Pascuita, Felicita le pregunta a su hermana si entrego las llaves, Alegría se pone nerviosa y rápido Felicita sospecha que su hermana hizo algo, pero Alegría se escabulle y sale hacia en el estacionamiento, donde también se encuentra Matilde con su hijo, que le pide que maneje, pero el muchacho no quiere y su mamá no entiende que pasa pues la tarde anterior estuvo peleando con ella por una licencia de conducir, se le acerca Ramón en ese momento, se saludan con mucho cariño, momento que aprovechan los muchachos para aclarar que ellos no han dicho nada y que tampoco dirán nada, eso no es asunto de ellos, ellos no tuvieron nada que ver con el robo de ese carro. Luis Fernando da la noticia en su casa, le dice a su hermana que es esta seguro que fue Gerson, Cristina lo defiende, pudo haber sido otra persona como por ejemplo Alegría y Ernesto que para ella tenían una cara sospechosa al momento de entregar las llaves del carro, pero Luis Fernando no le da crédito a lo que dice su hermana, como es posible que Alegría esa niña tan decente haga una cosa de esas y mucho menos Ernesto su primo, no definitivamente su hermana esta loca, Egleé también se entera del robo del carro. Llega Luis Fernando a la oficina y echa el cuento del carro, le pide a Dileidi que le va tener que dar unas clases de cómo andar en las calles de Caracas sin vehiculo propio, en ese momento lo llaman y le dicen que ya fue atrapado la persona que el denuncio como autor del robo de su carro, de inmediato sale para allá, también Dileidi recibe una llamada es su hermano Gerson que le dice que esta detenido y que lo ayude, ella le pide el favor a Aureliano que la lleve para la jefatura, una vez allí se encuentran los dos, se dicen los motivos por los cuales se encuentran allí, solo que Dileidi le dice que su hermano esta detenido por que no tenía sus documentación de identificación y que por eso estaba ahí, pero en ese momento traen a Gerson y Luis Fernando dice que esa fue la rata que le robo el carro, Dileidi se quiere morir, no puede ser que haya sido su hermano, al enterarse Luis Fernando que Gerson es hermano de Dileidi se quiere morir igual. Llaman a Gladis y le dan la mala noticia, también se va para la jefatura. Aristigueta llega a la casa de la Nena y su hija le echa el cuento de que Gerson se robo un carro con pistola en mano, Aristigueta aprovecha para decirle a la Nena que seguramente fueron los dos, por que Theo es un delincuente, la Nena le recuerda que ella siempre ha tenido mala suerte para conseguirse con maridos delincuentes. Cuando llega Gladis a la jefatura, llega armando un escándalo, pide que le expliquen que pasa con su hijo, cuando se entera del asunto y quien fue que denuncio a su hijo, Luis Fernando no haya que decirle a Gladis, no le cabe la pena, no sabe que decir, ella le reprocha que la tiene agarrada con sus hijos que primero fue con Dileidi y ahora es con Gerson. Cristina y María Gracia encuentran el carro chocado pero lo encuentran. Gladis entra a la celda donde esta su hijo, lo regaña, no lo escucha, hasta que por fin Gerson le cuenta que estuvo con Doroteo, que la fiesta termino con una pelea y entonces Gladis recuerda que fue lo mismo que le contó la Nena, le da gracias a dios que su hijo no fue el que robo el carro. La Nena le cuenta su tragedia a su amiga Rosa, dice que esta decidida a quedarse sola, Rosa le dice que quien le da alegría a ella es Theo que se lo piense mejor. Egleé le advierte a su hijo que si Gladis se le va y no quiere trabajar mas es por su culpa, que tendrá que decirle a la miss que le lave y le planche la ropa, el muchacho esta preocupado pues esta seguro que ahora si es verdad que perdió todas las esperanzas de recuperar a Dileidi, pues esta seguro que después de esta metida de pata nadie en esa familia lo perdonará y a ella le pasa igual, cree que el no querrá tener un cuñado como Gerson.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 50: Comienza la Venganza Esperada
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo y Daniela presionan a Inés para que les diga en que trabaja y porque Robert le paga tanto dinero, pero la llegada de éste impide que ella hable y autoriza a Robert para que lo diga, pero él calla y les dice que no les dirá nada. Armando y Sorbella son atacados por unos malandros que los sacan del carro y los meten en una camioneta y se los llevan, después Reinaldo y Walter que son los asaltantes se ríen y se alegran de que al fin comience la venganza que tanto esperaban. Flavia se enfrenta a Michelle quien le reclama porque ella quiere denunciar a Armando por la agresión de la que hizo víctima a Marisela, pero Diego Andrés habla y declara que está decidido a ser él quien presente la denuncia.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada se casa con Salomón y se va a vivir a su casa…Inmaculada le pide a Sonia y Pedro, que vayan a buscar algunas cosas a la mansión Humboldt, porque este matrimonio no va a durar mucho tiempo. Salomón le dice a Inmaculada que él se casó con ella, para ser su juez, su cárcel, y va a hacerle pagar con dolor, cada angustia, terror, desolación, todo lo que él pasó en la cárcel por culpa de ella. Alejandro empieza a sospechar que Abril e Inmaculada le ocultan algo acerca de Salomón y enfrenta a Abril, quien le dice que Salomón pagó cárcel por ella, y lo hizo para que ella quedara libre…Y que por esa razón, Inmaculada lo dejó a Alejandro plantado el día de su boda.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 62: El Escape y el Documento Firmado
programme.desc: Salvador les da tremenda golpiza a los escoltas de Don Carlos y logra escapar con Socorro.María acepta acostarse con Don Carlos, pero le pone como condición que firme un documento en el que diga que los exámenes de doping de El Tigre fueron adulterados. Don Carlos acepta y aparentemente firma el documento ante notario.Julio César le dice a Josefina que Charo lo amenazó de muerte, pero Charo se hace la inocente y responde que es un invento de Julio César.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 62: La Violencia y la Desconfianza Matrimonial
programme.desc: Arelys se defiende de la agresión de Pantoja quien al percatarse de su temor recapacita sobre su violenta actitud al prometerle su todavía esposa no hacerle daño pese a su desconfianza y a los antecedentes de violencia descriptos por Arelys, Pantoja le fija su posición a Arelys al mostrarle su negativa de permitirle ningún tipo de desliz extra matrimonial con Gabriel, al saber a su esposa interesada en conquistar al afamado medico. Gabriela se apoya en el consuelo de Flavia tras atravesar por el dilema de ser la victima de la desconfianza de Gabriel. Ramón cubre sus espaldas de ser descubierto en sus andanzas por su esposa Berta al entrar a su casa por la puerta trasera.

Cuando llega Gladis a la jefatura, llega armando un escándalo, pide que le expliquen que pasa con su hijo, cuando se entera del asunto y quien fue que denuncio a su hijo, Luis Fernando no haya que decirle a Gladis, no le cabe la pena, no sabe que decir, ella le reprocha que la tiene agarrada con sus hijos que primero fue con Dileidi y ahora es con Gerson. Cristina y María Gracia encuentran el carro chocado pero lo encuentran. Gladis entra a la celda donde esta su hijo, lo regaña, no lo escucha, hasta que por fin Gerson le cuenta que estuvo con Doroteo, que la fiesta termino con una pelea y entonces Gladis recuerda que fue lo mismo que le contó la Nena, le da gracias a dios que su hijo no fue el que robo el carro. La Nena le cuenta su tragedia a su amiga Rosa, dice que esta decidida a quedarse sola, Rosa le dice que quien le da alegría a ella es Theo que se lo piense mejor. Egleé le advierte a su hijo que si Gladis se le va y no quiere trabajar mas es por su culpa, que tendrá que decirle a la miss que le lave y le planche la ropa, el muchacho esta preocupado pues esta seguro que ahora si es verdad que perdió todas las esperanzas de recuperar a Dileidi, pues esta seguro que después de esta metida de pata nadie en esa familia lo perdonará y a ella le pasa igual, cree que el no querrá tener un cuñado como Gerson.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 50: Comienza la Venganza Esperada
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo y Daniela presionan a Inés para que les diga en que trabaja y porque Robert le paga tanto dinero, pero la llegada de éste impide que ella hable y autoriza a Robert para que lo diga, pero él calla y les dice que no les dirá nada. Armando y Sorbella son atacados por unos malandros que los sacan del carro y los meten en una camioneta y se los llevan, después Reinaldo y Walter que son los asaltantes se ríen y se alegran de que al fin comience la venganza que tanto esperaban. Flavia se enfrenta a Michelle quien le reclama porque ella quiere denunciar a Armando por la agresión de la que hizo víctima a Marisela, pero Diego Andrés habla y declara que está decidido a ser él quien presente la denuncia.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada se casa con Salomón y se va a vivir a su casa…Inmaculada le pide a Sonia y Pedro, que vayan a buscar algunas cosas a la mansión Humboldt, porque este matrimonio no va a durar mucho tiempo. Salomón le dice a Inmaculada que él se casó con ella, para ser su juez, su cárcel, y va a hacerle pagar con dolor, cada angustia, terror, desolación, todo lo que él pasó en la cárcel por culpa de ella. Alejandro empieza a sospechar que Abril e Inmaculada le ocultan algo acerca de Salomón y enfrenta a Abril, quien le dice que Salomón pagó cárcel por ella, y lo hizo para que ella quedara libre…Y que por esa razón, Inmaculada lo dejó a Alejandro plantado el día de su boda.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 62: El Escape y el Documento Firmado
programme.desc: Salvador les da tremenda golpiza a los escoltas de Don Carlos y logra escapar con Socorro.María acepta acostarse con Don Carlos, pero le pone como condición que firme un documento en el que diga que los exámenes de doping de El Tigre fueron adulterados. Don Carlos acepta y aparentemente firma el documento ante notario.Julio César le dice a Josefina que Charo lo amenazó de muerte, pero Charo se hace la inocente y responde que es un invento de Julio César.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 62: La Violencia y la Desconfianza Matrimonial
programme.desc: Arelys se defiende de la agresión de Pantoja quien al percatarse de su temor recapacita sobre su violenta actitud al prometerle su todavía esposa no hacerle daño pese a su desconfianza y a los antecedentes de violencia descriptos por Arelys, Pantoja le fija su posición a Arelys al mostrarle su negativa de permitirle ningún tipo de desliz extra matrimonial con Gabriel, al saber a su esposa interesada en conquistar al afamado medico. Gabriela se apoya en el consuelo de Flavia tras atravesar por el dilema de ser la victima de la desconfianza de Gabriel. Ramón cubre sus espaldas de ser descubierto en sus andanzas por su esposa Berta al entrar a su casa por la puerta trasera.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 105: El Robo y La Detencion
programme.desc: Luis Fernando insiste que quien le robo su carro fue el vigilante del edificio de enfrente, pone a todo el mundo en aviso, la presidenta del condominio le da los datos personales de Gerson. Mientras Gerson se dirige a su trabajo en compañía de Yuraima es esta seguro de que no pasa nada si llega un poco tarde ese día, se encuentran con que la policía detiene el trafico y la sorpresa es para ellos pues se llevan detenido a Gerson, el esta seguro de no haber hecho nada pero el agente le dice que tiene una denuncia por el robo de un carro y en ella aparece el nombre de el, Yuraima desesperada grita, pero igualito se lo llevan, ella se va para donde Gabito y le pide ayuda. En ese momento Gabito esta en compañía de Theo, quien aún no se le pasa la pena de la noche anterior, cuando llega Yuraima llorando y contándole a Gabito lo que acaba de ocurrir, Theo le dice que no puede ser por que ellos estaban en una fiesta la noche anterior, se van los tres para la jefatura, Gabito deja encargado de la bodega a Remedios pero a quien deja encargado de la caja es a Hector, pues en el si confía. La Nena le esta contando a Gladis el chasco de la noche anterior, Gladis le dice que todo le pasa por andar siempre con una mentira, que si hubiera sido sincera no le pasan tantas cosas. En la casa de Pascuita, Felicita le pregunta a su hermana si entrego las llaves, Alegría se pone nerviosa y rápido Felicita sospecha que su hermana hizo algo, pero Alegría se escabulle y sale hacia en el estacionamiento, donde también se encuentra Matilde con su hijo, que le pide que maneje, pero el muchacho no quiere y su mamá no entiende que pasa pues la tarde anterior estuvo peleando con ella por una licencia de conducir, se le acerca Ramón en ese momento, se saludan con mucho cariño, momento que aprovechan los muchachos para aclarar que ellos no han dicho nada y que tampoco dirán nada, eso no es asunto de ellos, ellos no tuvieron nada que ver con el robo de ese carro. Luis Fernando da la noticia en su casa, le dice a su hermana que es esta seguro que fue Gerson, Cristina lo defiende, pudo haber sido otra persona como por ejemplo Alegría y Ernesto que para ella tenían una cara sospechosa al momento de entregar las llaves del carro, pero Luis Fernando no le da crédito a lo que dice su hermana, como es posible que Alegría esa niña tan decente haga una cosa de esas y mucho menos Ernesto su primo, no definitivamente su hermana esta loca, Egleé también se entera del robo del carro. Llega Luis Fernando a la oficina y echa el cuento del carro, le pide a Dileidi que le va tener que dar unas clases de cómo andar en las calles de Caracas sin vehiculo propio, en ese momento lo llaman y le dicen que ya fue atrapado la persona que el denuncio como autor del robo de su carro, de inmediato sale para allá, también Dileidi recibe una llamada es su hermano Gerson que le dice que esta detenido y que lo ayude, ella le pide el favor a Aureliano que la lleve para la jefatura, una vez allí se encuentran los dos, se dicen los motivos por los cuales se encuentran allí, solo que Dileidi le dice que su hermano esta detenido por que no tenía sus documentación de identificación y que por eso estaba ahí, pero en ese momento traen a Gerson y Luis Fernando dice que esa fue la rata que le robo el carro, Dileidi se quiere morir, no puede ser que haya sido su hermano, al enterarse Luis Fernando que Gerson es hermano de Dileidi se quiere morir igual. Llaman a Gladis y le dan la mala noticia, también se va para la jefatura. Aristigueta llega a la casa de la Nena y su hija le echa el cuento de que Gerson se robo un carro con pistola en mano, Aristigueta aprovecha para decirle a la Nena que seguramente fueron los dos, por que Theo es un delincuente, la Nena le recuerda que ella siempre ha tenido mala suerte para conseguirse con maridos delincuentes. La Nena le cuenta su tragedia a su amiga Rosa, dice que esta decidida a quedarse sola, Rosa le dice que quien le da alegría a ella es Theo que se lo piense mejor. Egleé le advierte a su hijo que si Gladis se le va y no quiere trabajar mas es por su culpa, que tendrá que decirle a la miss que le lave y le planche la ropa, el muchacho esta preocupado pues esta seguro que ahora si es verdad que perdió todas las esperanzas de recuperar a Dileidi, pues esta seguro que después de esta metida de pata nadie en esa familia lo perdonará y a ella le pasa igual, cree que el no querrá tener un cuñado como Gerson.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Alejandro se entera de que Abril sabe la razón por la cual Inmaculada lo dejó plantado en el altar pero no le quiere decir y le responde que le pregunta el motivo a Inmaculada. Alejandro también se da cuenta de que su padre, Ángel sabe algo pero este tampoco le quiere contar nada. El peludo le regala un auto a Pelusa y le dice que como el corre riesgo de muerte quiere dejar toda su fortuna a nombre de ella. Pelusa ve a Josué trabajando en una obra en construcción pero luego se aleja y se va en su camioneta nueva sin hablar con él.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 63: El plan de Don Carlos
programme.desc: Socorro evade a Josefina diciéndole que pronto le presentará al hombre con quien está, así que Josefina se retira de la habitación, pero en seguida intenta sobornar a Helena para que le diga el nombre del novio de Cocó, sin embargo Helena no cede ante el dinero. Socorro le insiste a Salvador que le digan a Josefina sobre su relación, pues ella y su padre son de origen humilde y está segura que los apoyarán, pero Salvador no está de acuerdo, él está convencido que Josefina los va a separar.Don Carlos les ordena a sus escoltas que arroyen a Salvador, pero lejos de la presencia de María para que ella no sufra.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 63: Celos, Descubrimientos y Gran Impacto
programme.desc: Gabriel se deja invadir por los celos acrecentando aun mas su desconfianza en contra de Marisela al ver a esta en compañía de Reynaldo. El padre Venancio ayuda a Jesús a reincorporarse en su silla de ruedas al este informarlo sobre su gran error tras haber alertado a Ricardo de la gran fortuna que le fue despojada a su esposa tras ser heredera del difunto Ricardo. Alfonso descubre en Brillante un alma similar en gustos y perversidad al recibir de ella un estrafalario obsequio. Al estar acompañada por sus compañeros de universidad, Gabriela se ve victima de un gran impacto al ser informada por Giancarlos y sus amigos de la verdadera condición social y económica de su novio Ricardo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 106: La verdad sale a la luz
programme.desc: A Luis Fernando se le pierde algo en la oficina, le pregunta a todo el mundo si han visto el pen drive que perdió, le pregunta a Dileidi pero como ella esta algo sentida por lo que le paso a su hermano se pone de inmediato a la defensiva, el se disculpa, le dice que el no sabía que Gerson era su hermano, que de haberlo sabido lo hubiese arreglado de otra manera, ella también esta apenada pues sabe el prontuario de su hermano y ahora los dos piensan que ya para ellos después de ese problema seguro que no tendrán mas oportunidad de estar juntos. La mayoría celebra que Gerson este preso, entre esas están la Felicita y Maria Gracia, Cristina por su parte lo defiende de todo el mundo, cuando Tatiana escucha aclara que no pudo haber sido el quien robo el carro de Luis Fernando pues el estaba la noche anterior en la fiesta de su papá y en compañía de Doroteo, a Felicita le molesta que Tatiana haya dicho que eso, tiene que decir solo cosas que perjudiquen al muchacho, en ese momento llega del colegio Alegría y se entera que el hijo de Gladis esta preso por su culpa. Todos hacen leña del árbol caído, por su parte Pascuita despedirá a Gladis, no puede aceptar que una persona con un hijo malandro trabaje en su casa, Matilde habla en defensa de Gladis, le recuerda que es una mujer de confianza, que toda la vida a ha trabajado para todas ellas, Pascuita recuerda el incidente cuando se perdió el vestido de Cristina, Matilde insiste en defender a Gladis, Ramón también esta de acuerdo con que Gladis no es culpable de nada, Gonzalo por su parte apoya lo dicho por Pascuita ya van a empezar pascuita y Matilde a dispararse indirectas cuando los hijos de ambas interrumpen la guerra que digo la discusión y les dicen a sus padres que fueron ellos quienes se robaron el carro y quienes lo chocaron, todos quedan en shock. Gabito le da a poyo a Gladis, le dice que de esa también saldrán ella le agradece su posición tan incondicional para con ella, en eso llega Remedios, y después de preguntarle a Gladis por su hijo le hace cariños a Gabito delante de Gladis, le dice que le preparo un mondongo y Gladis se siente mal, se pone celosa, a Gabito le huele a quemado y remedios tiene que retirarse, empiezan a pelear en voz baja, Gladis le dice que el esta bien con Remedios, el le recuerda que el a quien quiere de verdad es a ella, pero que ella tiene miedo, en cambio Remedios lo quiere, lo cuida, lo respeta y eso es lo que el quiere, ella le dice que un pajarito le dijo que Remedios lo quería pero para cambiarlo. La Nena quiere hablar con Theo, quiere aclararle que ella no tuvo nada que ver con esa fiesta, pero el cuando ve que es ella quien lo llama no responde, esta con Rosa y le pide que apure lo del divorcio, que quizás si eso no hubiera pasado el le contesta el teléfono, pero que ya se canso de que se burlen de el, Rosa trata por todos los medios de que Theo cambie de opinión pero el esta muy decidido. La que se alegra de que Theo no responda el teléfono es Tatiana, quien le recuerda a su mamá que lo mejor es lo que pasa y que si ya paso eso entre ellos que se resigne, la Nena le recuerda que ella lo único que quiere es lavar su imagen pues no quiere que ni Theo ni nadie piensen que ella tuvo algo que ver con ese espectáculo tan bochornoso. Santiago invita a Egleé para el cine, ella dice que solos no por que no estaría bien, entonces Santiago invita a todo el personal de la oficina y el paga la entrada pero eso si el escoge la película, Luis Fernando le reclama que este organizando salidas pues se la esta poniendo fácil a Aureliano, mientras que el ya perdió todas las oportunidades con Dileidi. Llega Luis Fernando a su casa y lo esperan los que le robaron el carro con sus respectivas madres, Luis Fernando no entiende nada al principio, su hermana bromea, luego los muchachos le dicen que fueron ellos quienes robaron su carro y de paso lo chocaron, Luis Fernando se siente peor, ahora si ya no hay dudas el hermano de Dileidi es inocente de todo los cargos que el hizo, se siente mal, pide que lo dejen solo, luego se va a la comisaría y reconoce que hizo algo que no debía, declara que Gerson no fue quien robo su carro, firma unos documentos y espera a que salga Gerson, quien se burla de el, le acepta la disculpa pero le recuerda que su mamá y su hermana no lo perdonarán tan fácilmente, pues a las López no se les olvida un agravio. Aureliano invita a Dileidi a salir, esta al principio se niega pero su amiga Yenilu la convence de que vaya y así lo hace. Betzaida entra en cólera cuando se entera que Rómulo le echo el cuento primero a Egleé que a ella que es su esposa, siempre es Egleé la que tiene preferencia en la vida de Rómulo. Pascuita y Ramón regañan a su hija, luego discuten ellos pues Ramón pretende que su mujer se disculpe con Matilde por haberle dicho mala madre, cosa que por supuesto pascuita no esta dispuesta hacer, por su parte Matilde también regaña a su hijo, luego se forma una pelea igual con Gonzalo, lo único que Matilde le pide a su hijo es que no le cuente nada delante de la bruja de pascuita. Gladis esta contenta por que ya su hijo esta libre y eso demuestra que esta vez el no tuvo nada que ver con eso, Egleé esta preocupada por lo que le pueda pasar al hijo de Gladis y peor aún por que si ella se queda sin Gladis es el acabose, Marco Aurelio llama a Gladis y se pone a la orden para cualquier cosa que necesite, ella le dice que ya su hijo esta libre, Marco Aurelio aprovecha para coquetear con Gladis a ella le gusta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una furibunda Rutila encara a su padre, por robarle su dinero. Pastrana ubica a uno de los hijos de Aurelio. Mónica reclama a Víctor la trata de blancas. Penumbra intenta extorsionar a Javier.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony Pastrana llega a Colombia para vengarse de los Casillas. Ordena el primer asesinato. Interrogan a Arelys y, asustada, informa sobre Juan Carlos y Pina. Rivero vigila a Dalvio y la Tata.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doble 30 le ofrece tres toneladas de droga a Aurelio. Casillas protesta. El paramilitar lo amenaza con entregarlo a las autoridades o a Víctor. Mónica pide que la dejen ir. Víctor se deprime.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El recado de Tony llega a oídos de Aurelio. Casillas enfurece por la muerte de su hijo, Nazareno. Piensa en la guerra que se desatará y cómo cuidarse. Tocan el corazón de la Felina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Inauguran el local de Víctor, pero pronto la fiesta se convertirá en un escenario de horror y pánico. Juan Carlos intenta sobornar a un agente federal. La Felina recibe una visita inesperada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En medio del caos, Sebastián ayuda a Rutila. Necesita un buen abogado para presentar las quejas al presidente, luego de que un guardia le quitara el celular. Le llaman la atención a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar muerde el anzuelo que le tiende Rodrigo y se presenta con Castillo en busca de Rutila. Los periodistas lo estan esperando. Para no verse involucrado, destituye a Rodrigo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor confiesa que ya no puede más con tanto odio. Aurelio tiene una propuesta para él. Se llevan a Pilar. Rodrigo piensa en deshacerse de Paloma. Mónica debe explicar su nexo con Tony.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony Pastrana y Víctor pactan un encuentro, en que uno de los dos ganará la pelea a balazo limpio. Aurelio amenaza a Mónica: coopera para dar con el asesino de Nazareno o deja de ver a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rivero entra de incógnito a la cárcel, lleva un uniforme para Evelyn. Mónica insulta al presidente y lo echa de la casa. Colón y Salazar preparan un gran golpe al Cártel de los Soles.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pastrana piensa en el punto débil de Aurelio para vengarse. Colón y Rodrigo hablan de él y el ascenso de la droga en Estados Unidos. Rutila nota que la robaron. Doble 30 y Mónica planean la última carga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio confirma su traición a Feyo Aguilera. Le sugieren no enfrentar a los Maras y los Emes, que el gobierno lo haga, pero él rechaza la idea. Víctor quiere recuperar a Mónica. Rastrean a la Tata.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
